say:0:1720301001:0.text: Huh? Why hasn't the show started yet?

say:2:1720304001:1.source_cn: 完了，全完了！……这下可怎么办啊！今天的演出要泡汤了！

say:3:1720304002:0.text: And on the biggest festival of the year, of all times. Our host is injured, the prop master is down... This is it. This is the end for my troupe!

say:10:1720304006:1.text: The curtain's about to go up, and I still don't have the people I need to save this show!
say:10:1720304006:1.source_cn: 眼看演出就要开始，我实在是找不到人手来救场了！

say:11:1720304007:1.text: Hey, you two, just in time! Tell me, do you like theater? Ever wanted to be onstage? This might be your chance.

say:17:1720304012:1.text: Alright, alright, I'm doing what I can! But if I can't find help fast... there may not be a show tonight...

say:40:1720304027:1.source_cn: 主持人小姐！这是我们戏剧的剧本，总共分为四个部分，台词...

say:1:1720305002:0.source_cn: 道具师，让舞台中间那些道具魔物动起来吧！

say:1:1720305002:0.female: And miss, get those Hypofiend props moving!

say:4:1720306003:0.text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to this special performance for the Ascension Festival.
say:4:1720306003:0.source_cn: 女士们，先生们，欢迎来到升华庆典的特别舞台。

say:5:1720306004:0.text: Tonight, we're telling a very old story.
say:5:1720306004:0.source_cn: 我们今天要讲述的，是一个非常、非常古老的故事。

say:6:1720306005:0.text: It begins long before the Lightbearer Empire is founded, before heroes are remembered by name...
say:6:1720306005:0.source_cn: 在很久很久以前，当耀光帝国还未建立，当英雄的名字尚未被...

say:7:1720306006:0.source_cn: 黑暗的阴影笼罩着大地，嗜血的魔物在伊索米亚大陆上肆虐，...

say:8:1720306007:0.text: And above all of them stands one creature the people fear most: the Mirror Wraith.
say:8:1720306007:0.source_cn: 而其中最为残暴可怖的，便是名为魔灵镜影的庞大魔物——

say:2:1720308001:1.text: The young man, clutching a broken sword, falls into utter despair.
say:2:1720308001:1.source_cn: 就在年轻男人手持断剑，满眼绝望之际——

say:3:1720308002:0.text: At that moment, a divine figure emerges, wrapped in a soft light that doesn't seem to belong to this world. It is Dura, the ever-merciful goddess.
say:3:1720308002:0.source_cn: 一个神圣的身影缓缓出现，她周身笼罩在柔和的光晕之中，仿...

say:4:1720308003:0.text: She hears the cry of a brave mortal who refuses to give in, and she answers by placing hope in his hands.
say:4:1720308003:0.source_cn: 仁慈的女神艾雅，听到了凡人心中不屈的呐喊。她降下神迹，...

say:8:1720308006:1.text: I've seen your courage. Take this sword.
say:8:1720308006:1.source_cn: 你的勇气，我已见证。现在，我将这柄剑赐予你。

say:9:1720308007:0.text: But remember, the moment you accept it, your fate is no longer yours alone. You'll be carrying the future of all humanity on your shoulders.
say:9:1720308007:0.source_cn: 但你要记住，从你握住它的那一刻起，你所承担的，将不再只...

say:10:1720308008:0.source_cn: 你，愿意接受这份责任吗？

say:12:1720308010:1.text: I'll give everything I have to protect my home and end this disaster.
say:12:1720308010:1.source_cn: 为了守护我的家园，为了终结这场灾难，我愿献出我的一切。

say:14:1720308011:1.text: The moment his fingers touch the hilt, light bursts from the blade and floods the land. Dura has chosen him.
say:14:1720308011:1.source_cn: 当他的指尖触碰到剑柄的那一刻，耀眼的光芒从剑身上迸发，...

say:15:1720308012:1.text: And with that, the hero of the Lightbearer Empire is born.
say:15:1720308012:1.source_cn: 自此，耀光的英雄——诞生了！

say:2:1720310001:0.text: With Dura's blessing and the sacred sword in hand, the young hero drives back the Mirror Wraith. That victory gives people something they haven't felt in a long time: hope!
say:2:1720310001:0.source_cn: 获得了女神的赐福与神剑，年轻的英雄不再孤单！他击败魔灵...

say:3:1720310002:0.text: Before long, he isn't fighting alone! Warriors gather at his side, smiths forge armor for him, and the people send him off with their blessings!
say:3:1720310002:0.source_cn: 他不再是一个人在战斗！在他的感召下，战士们集结于他的麾...

say:2:1720312001:0.text: He leads his army from one battle to the next.
say:2:1720312001:0.source_cn: 英雄带领着他的军队，与一波又一波魔物展开了激烈的战斗。

say:7:1720312004:0.text: Little by little, the tide turns. At last, the Hypofiends are driven back!
say:7:1720312004:0.source_cn: 就这样，在英雄的带领下，人类的军队节节胜利，最终将恶魔...

say:8:1720312005:0.text: To celebrate this great victory and protect the peace won at such a high cost, that hero builds a kingdom for all humankind.
say:8:1720312005:0.source_cn: 为了纪念这场伟大的胜利，为了守护这来之不易的和平，这位...

say:0:1720313001:0.text: Alright, clear the Hypofiends and bring in the platform!
say:0:1720313001:0.source_cn: 就是现在，那些道具魔物该回收了，换成高台！

say:0:1720313001:0.female: Alright, clear the Hypofiends and bring in the platform!

say:0:1720314001:0.text: And give me petals. We need this to feel like a celebration!

say:0:1720314001:0.male: And give me petals. We need this to feel like a celebration!
say:0:1720314001:0.female: And give me petals. We need this to feel like a celebration!

say:2:1720316001:1.text: Under Rolan's wise rule, the shadow of Divine War begins to fade. The people who once had nowhere safe to go are finally able to live in peace again.

say:3:1720316002:0.text: And the Lightbearer Empire enters an age of lasting prosperity.
say:3:1720316002:0.source_cn: 耀光帝国，迎来了长久的繁荣。

say:4:1720316003:0.text: But years later, on a night bright with stars, he summons the companion he trusts most...
say:4:1720316003:0.source_cn: 然而，在一个星辰满布的神秘夜晚，他独自召见了自己最信任...

say:2:1720320001:1.text: My dear friend. I drink to you, and to all who gave their lives for the Lightbearer Empire.

say:3:1720320002:1.text: The empire has at last been set upon its proper course. My duty... is done.

say:5:1720320004:1.text: Your Majesty... are you leaving us?
say:5:1720320004:1.source_cn: 大帝……你要离开我们了吗……

say:6:1720320005:1.text: Before I go, there is one last thing.
say:6:1720320005:1.source_cn: 临别之前，尚有最后一事——

say:7:1720320006:1.text: By Dura's will, the sacred sword shall rest in stone. Until it is drawn, the throne shall remain empty. The one who draws it shall be crowned.
say:7:1720320006:1.source_cn: 奉艾雅之意：圣剑归于磐石，圣剑不出，王座空悬，圣剑出鞘...

say:9:1720320007:1.text: Rolan places the sacred sword, symbol of divine favor and royal authority, into the stone given by Dura. The moment he does, he disappears from sight.
say:9:1720320007:1.source_cn: 罗兰大帝将那柄象征着神恩与王权的圣剑，插入了艾雅赐予的...

say:10:1720320008:1.text: But before he departs, he leaves one final decree: From that day on, the next ruler of the empire will be chosen by the sword, now known as Excalibur.
say:10:1720320008:1.source_cn: 在那之前，他留下了最后的旨意——从今往后，耀光的继承人...

say:11:1720320009:1.text: Only the one accepted by Excalibur may become the next ruler of the Lightbearer Empire. And so that sacred decree is passed down through the generations!
say:11:1720320009:1.source_cn: 唯有被石中剑认可之人，方能成为耀光的新王。这个神圣的仪...

say:0:1720322001:0.text: We did it. The show couldn't have gone better!
say:0:1720322001:0.source_cn: 演出完美结束！太感谢你们了！

say:2:1720323001:1.text: Perfect! Absolutely perfect! You didn't just save tonight's performance. You may have saved the whole troupe! How am I ever supposed to repay you?!
say:2:1720323001:1.source_cn: 完美！简直是完美的演出！两位，你们拯救了我的戏剧！拯救...
say:2:1720323001:1.male: Perfect! Absolutely perfect! You didn't just save tonight's performance. You may have saved the whole troupe! How am I ever supposed to repay you?!
say:2:1720323001:1.female: Perfect! Absolutely perfect! You didn't just save tonight's performance. You may have saved the whole troupe! How am I ever supposed to repay you?!

choice_prompt:3:1720323001.source_cn: 完美！简直是完美的演出！两位，你们拯救了我的戏剧！拯救了我的剧团！我该怎么感谢你们才好！
choice_prompt:3:1720323001.male: Perfect! Absolutely perfect! You didn't just save tonight's performance. You may have saved the whole troupe! How am I ever supposed to repay you?!
choice_prompt:3:1720323001.female: Perfect! Absolutely perfect! You didn't just save tonight's performance. You may have saved the whole troupe! How am I ever supposed to repay you?!

say:4:1720323002:1.text: A play about a great mage? Sure! With your talent, I wouldn't be surprised if one day your name was spoken in the same breath as the legendary Merlin's.
say:4:1720323002:1.source_cn: 魔法题材的故事吗？您的魔法技艺高超，我敢说，假以时日，...
say:4:1720323002:1.male: A play about a great mage? Sure! With your talent, I wouldn't be surprised if one day your name was spoken in the same breath as the legendary Merlin's.
say:4:1720323002:1.female: A play about a great mage? Sure! With your talent, I wouldn't be surprised if one day your name was spoken in the same breath as the legendary Merlin's.

say:5:1720323003:1.text: Though if I'm going to write something worthy of you, I'll need time to do you justice...
say:5:1720323003:1.source_cn: 只是……要为您量身定做一部剧，我得构思构思故事内容才行……
say:5:1720323003:1.male: Though if I'm going to write something worthy of you, I'll need time to do you justice...
say:5:1720323003:1.female: Though if I'm going to write something worthy of you, I'll need time to do you justice...

say:6:1720323007:1.text: Then maybe you don't need to choose at all. Merlin is standing right in front of you.
say:6:1720323007:1.male: Then maybe you don't need to choose at all. Merlin is standing right in front of you.
say:6:1720323007:1.female: Then maybe you don't need to choose at all. Merlin is standing right in front of you.

say:7:1720323008:1.text: ... What? Wait... You're Merlin? The Merlin?!
say:7:1720323008:1.source_cn: ……什么？您……您就是……那个……传说中的……
say:7:1720323008:1.male: ... What? Wait... You're Merlin? The Merlin?!
say:7:1720323008:1.female: ... What? Wait... You're Merlin? The Merlin?!

say:8:1720323009:1.text: Dura above... I've been standing here talking to Merlin himself this whole time! The legend in the flesh!
say:8:1720323009:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上！活着的传奇……一部行走的史诗……我竟然……我...
say:8:1720323009:1.male: Dura above... I've been standing here talking to Merlin himself this whole time! The legend in the flesh!
say:8:1720323009:1.female: Dura above... I've been standing here talking to Merlin herself this whole time! The legend in the flesh!

say:9:1720323010:1.text: This is it! I can feel it. My next play has to be about you! No, not just my next play. This has to be the greatest thing I've ever written!
say:9:1720323010:1.source_cn: 梅林阁下！我的灵感正在熊熊燃烧！下一部戏！不，我此生的...
say:9:1720323010:1.male: This is it! I can feel it. My next play has to be about you! No, not just my next play. This has to be the greatest thing I've ever written!
say:9:1720323010:1.female: This is it! I can feel it. My next play has to be about you! No, not just my next play. This has to be the greatest thing I've ever written!

say:10:1720323011:0.text: The Trials of Merlin... Secrets of the Great Mage... No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. We need to sit down and talk. A life like yours deserves a story worthy of it!
say:10:1720323011:0.source_cn: 《梅林的试炼》、《首席的秘密》、《救世的魔法师》……哦...
say:10:1720323011:0.male: The Trials of Merlin... Secrets of the Great Mage... No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. We need to sit down and talk. A life like yours deserves a story worthy of it!
say:10:1720323011:0.female: The Trials of Merlin... Secrets of the Great Mage... No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. We need to sit down and talk. A life like yours deserves a story worthy of it!

choice_prompt:11:1720323011.male: The Trials of Merlin... Secrets of the Great Mage... No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. We need to sit down and talk. A life like yours deserves a story worthy of it!

say:12:1720323012:1.text: You're right. I got carried away! I'll gather more material, take some time with it, and come back when I'm ready to talk script!
say:12:1720323012:1.source_cn: 是我太心急了！待我收集更多的资料，稍加酝酿，再邀您详谈...
say:12:1720323012:1.male: You're right. I got carried away! I'll gather more material, take some time with it, and come back when I'm ready to talk script!
say:12:1720323012:1.female: You're right. I got carried away! I'll gather more material, take some time with it, and come back when I'm ready to talk script!

say:13:1720323013:1.text: Director, there's something I've been meaning to ask...
say:13:1720323013:1.source_cn: 导演先生，对于戏剧的剧本，我有一点小小的疑惑……

say:14:1720323014:1.text: Was tonight's play actually based on King Rolan's real story?
say:14:1720323014:1.source_cn: 所以，今天的这出戏剧……演绎的是初代国王罗兰大帝真实的...

say:15:1720323015:1.text: You know, once a story reaches the stage, it stops being history and starts becoming theater!
say:15:1720323015:1.source_cn: 小姐，您要知道，艺术创作嘛……总是要源于生活，但必须高...

say:16:1720323016:1.text: As for which parts are true and which ones we might have embellished a little... where's the fun in giving that away? The magic of theater is letting the audience wonder, isn't it?
say:16:1720323016:1.source_cn: 至于哪些是真，哪些是假，就留给观众们去想象吧！这才是戏...

choice:11:1:2.text: You don't have to figure it all out today!
choice:11:1:2.male: You don't have to figure it all out today!
choice:11:1:2.female: You don't have to figure it all out today!

choice:3:0:1.source_cn: 写部以我为主角的戏吧

say:19:1720323004:1.text: That's a great idea! How did that not occur to me? Merlin... of course! Magic, danger, epic adventures—it's got everything we need for a stage show!
say:19:1720323004:1.source_cn: 好主意！我怎么没想到呢！重现大魔法师梅林波澜壮阔的冒险史诗！
say:19:1720323004:1.male: That's a great idea! How did that not occur to me? Merlin... of course! Magic, danger, epic adventures—it's got everything we need for a stage show!
say:19:1720323004:1.female: That's a great idea! How did that not occur to me? Merlin... of course! Magic, danger, epic adventures—it's got everything we need for a stage show!

say:20:1720323005:1.text: The very thought of it is enough to get my blood pumping. So, you're a fan of the Merlin legends too?
say:20:1720323005:1.source_cn: 这题材，光是想想就让人热血沸腾！原来您也是梅林传说的爱...
say:20:1720323005:1.male: The very thought of it is enough to get my blood pumping. So, you're a fan of the Merlin legends too?
say:20:1720323005:1.female: The very thought of it is enough to get my blood pumping. So, you're a fan of the Merlin legends too?

say:21:1720323006:1.text: Though now that I say it out loud, that does leave me with one problem. There are so many stories about Merlin, I wouldn't know which one to start with...
say:21:1720323006:1.source_cn: 只是关于大魔法师梅林的传说故事实在太多，具体改编上演哪...
say:21:1720323006:1.male: Though now that I say it out loud, that does leave me with one problem. There are so many stories about Merlin, I wouldn't know which one to start with...
say:21:1720323006:1.female: Though now that I say it out loud, that does leave me with one problem. There are so many stories about Merlin, I wouldn't know which one to start with...

choice:3:1:2.text: Make the next play about Merlin.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 下部戏排演梅林传奇吧
choice:3:1:2.male: Make the next play about Merlin.
choice:3:1:2.female: Make the next play about Merlin.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1720311001:.text: Commander Rolan, let me fight beside you!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1720311003:.text: I made this armor for you!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1720319001:.text: The time has come for me to say farewell.

cinematic_dialogue:1:1720319002:.text: Your Majesty... what do you mean?
